v3.unsympathetic_critique: Every paragraph runs the same chassis — state a snail fact, pivot, land an aphorism about humanity — until the meter itself becomes the thing being read.

v3.1.unsympathetic_critique: The essayist has visibly worked at varying the move from paragraph to paragraph — opening one paragraph by dismantling its own aphorism, closing the essay by turning the irony on himself, breaking another paragraph to refuse the snail as an emblem of restraint — but the prose still relies on the fact-followed-by-humanity-verdict shape in about a quarter of paragraphs, and the breaks read as visible engineering rather than a settled new register.
